### Do You Follow Blindly?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-october-7-2024.html
Passage: Galatians 1:7-9
Points:
- Christian leaders must be tested by whether their primary message is the gospel of grace.
- Jesus Christ and His gift of salvation are the central hero and theme of Scripture.
- Distorting the gospel carries eternal consequences that lead people to destruction.
- Believers must actively practice discernment to distinguish biblical truth from counterfeit messages.

### False Teachers Accursed
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/false-teachers-accursed
Passage: Galatians 1:8-9
Points:
- Paul urgently rebukes the Galatians because departing from the true gospel forfeits salvation.
- Requiring good works or legal ceremonies for salvation undermines the sufficiency of Christ's atonement.
- Trusting human effort diminishes the gravity of sin and compromises the holiness of God.
- No teacher, whether apostle or angel, has the authority to change the gospel of grace.
- The written Word of God stands as the supreme authority over all church leaders and traditions.
